select:
SELECT * FROM acq_trml tt WHERE 1=1
and (tt.carr_chip_manuf ~ '^[0-9]+$' or tt.carr_chip_manuf is null)
and tt.carr_chip_manuf !~ '[^0-9]+'
and q.mgt_org_code ~ '[^0-9]+'

SELECT 'pap_r' || '~' || coalesce(tt.pap_r, '') || ',' || 'rap_r' || '~' || coalesce(tt.rap_r, '') || ',' || 'ia' || '~' || coalesce(tt.ia, '') || ',' || 'ua' || '~' || coalesce(tt.ua, '') AS str FROM acq_trml tt WHERE tt.asset_no = #{assetNo}

SELECT * FROM stat_data sd WHERE 1=1
and sd.data_date >= to_date(#{statDate} || '-01', 'yyyy-mm-dd hh24:mi:ss') and sd.data_date < to_date(#{statDate} || '-01', 'yyyy-mm-dd hh24:mi:ss') + interval '1' month
and sd.data_date >= to_date(#{statDate} || '-01-01', 'yyyy-mm-dd hh24:mi:ss') and sd.data_date < to_date(#{statDate} || '-01-01', 'yyyy-mm-dd hh24:mi:ss') + interval '1' year

SELECT * FROM task_data td WHERE td.stat_date = to_date(#{statDate}, 'yyyy-mm-dd hh24:mi:ss') AND td.start_date >= to_date(#{startDate}, 'yyyy-mm-dd hh24:mi:ss') AND td.end_date <= to_date(#{endDate}, 'yyyy-mm-dd hh24:mi:ss')
